description: Interactive glossary with search filtering and scroll-spy letter tracking; copyable term permalinks are opt-in

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder text for the injected search input (a hint, not its label — see data-label-filter)

attributes.name: permalinks
attributes.description: Add a copy-link # beside each term that has an id. Off by default: a glossary is mostly linked to, from terms in prose

attributes.name: data-label-filter
attributes.description: Accessible name of the search input

attributes.name: data-label-matches-one
attributes.description: Polite match-count announcement for the Intl.PluralRules "one" category ({count} is replaced). Any category works: -few, -many, -zero, -two.

attributes.name: data-label-matches-other
attributes.description: Match-count announcement for the "other" category and the fallback for unset categories

attributes.name: data-label-all-one
attributes.description: Announcement when the filter is cleared ("one" category)

attributes.name: data-label-all-other
attributes.description: Announcement when the filter is cleared ("other" category and fallback)

attributes.name: data-label-empty
attributes.description: Visible empty-state message when nothing matches

attributes.name: data-label-permalink
attributes.description: Permalink name prefix; the term text is appended

attributes.name: data-label-copied
attributes.description: Screen-reader announcement after a permalink copies the term URL

childAttributes.name: id
childAttributes.description: Term anchor: the target of links from prose and related terms (highlighted on arrival). With permalinks, each dt with an id also gets a # link that follows the fragment and copies the term URL.

structure.description: Letter jump navigation; its fragment links get aria-current="true" for the section in view and aria-disabled while their section is filtered out
One per letter group, with an id the jump links target (section[id^="glossary-"] also matches)
Terms inside each section: dt/dd groups (several dt per dd, several dd per dt, or div-wrapped groups)
The defined term inside dt; used as the filter target when present (otherwise the dt text)
